name: task-workspaces
description: A faster, SSD-friendly alternative to the built-in worktrees of Codex and Claude Code: isolated Git worktrees per task across one or more repositories, reused dependency installs via copy-on-write clones, checkpoints before cleanup and restore of removed folders.

interface.longDescription: A powerful alternative to built-in worktrees. Gives every coding task isolated Git worktrees in one or more repositories from a single project and chat, reuses verified dependency installs as copy-on-write clones instead of reinstalling, limits and cleans up disk use by policy, checkpoints unfinished work before removing a tree and restores it later. You choose where everything is stored.
defaultPrompt: Prepare isolated worktrees for this task
Show my task worktrees and disk usage
Pause this task and free its disk space
